versions.title: Reusable Units System
versions.origin: Major feature release adding a Figma-style reusable units (components) system — save canvas elements as reusable definitions with a per-user global library, type-tag categorization, search, drag-and-drop placement, definition editing with live instance sync, and 36 themed default units. Also includes cross-platform emoji rendering fixes, modal/dropdown UI hardening, and performance improvements.

sections.heading: Reusable Units System
items: Save any canvas element as a reusable Unit definition with one click (context menu or 'Add to Units')
Figma-style master/instance model: instances mirror their definition's visual properties; edit the definition to update all instances
Per-user global library persisted to disk, loaded on startup

36 themed default units across 3 palettes: Redora (Hover Agency), Qless (BoardFlow), CatarinaUI (Catarina + Hodor) — each with buttons, badges, cards, headings, inputs, navbars, progress bars, and alerts
Type-tag categorization: each unit carries an optional type tag (Text, Shape, Image, etc.) for organizing
Three group modes: Default (by theme), Custom (user-created), and By type
Search bar filters units by name across all groups
Context menu: Rename, Edit Properties, Delete, Move to group
Drag-and-drop placement onto the canvas
Definition editing panel with live instance sync
Group management: create, rename, delete, and inline-rename groups

sections.heading: Cross-Platform
items: Emoji rendering fixed on Linux: all emoji in the User Guide and ComponentsPanel replaced with lucide-react SVG icons

sections.heading: UI Fixes
items: Modal dropdown clipping: FilterableGroupSelect portals its dropdown to document.body
Empty groups now visible with an italic placeholder instead of being hidden
ContextMenu dismiss timing: outside-click listener delayed by one tick to prevent premature close
Sidebar panel opacity: bg.panel changed from translucent to opaque so content never shows through
White modal divider line: uses border.primary theme token instead of hardcoded borderColor

sections.heading: Performance
items: ComponentCreationModal refactored: outer shell subscribes only to the boolean flag; inner form mounts only when open, zero store overhead when closed

sections.heading: Quality
items: 1158 tests across 76 files
ESLint zero errors / zero warnings
TypeScript strict mode clean
Production build clean

versions.title: Styled Dialogs & Update UX
versions.origin: Polish release. Native Electron dialogs are replaced with styled in-app modals (About, auto-update prompts), the update flow gains a live checking state, an up-to-date confirmation, a network-timeout error dialog, and visible download progress bars, and the Keyboard Shortcuts reference gets clearer section headings.

sections.heading: Styled Dialogs
items: About Mockup Studio is now a styled modal (logo, version, creator, links) instead of a native system dialog
Auto-update prompts render as styled in-app dialogs (Update available / Ready to restart / Update failed)
Update checks show a live 'checking…' state with spinner
'You're up to date' confirmation when no newer version exists
Network-timeout guard (25s) so a blocked update check shows a clear error instead of hanging silently
Update download progress bars in the toolbar footer and canvas chrome bar

sections.heading: Keyboard Shortcuts
items: Section dividers between File / Edit / Canvas groups
Section titles use full-contrast theme colors (white in dark mode, black in light mode) so they read as headings, not shortcuts

sections.heading: Quality

Lint, typecheck, and production build clean

versions.title: Tool System & Masking Engine
versions.origin: Major release overhauling the tool system with a centralized Tool Manager, adding the complete mask engine with polygon boolean clipping, paint/eraser/blur/focus tools, a visual feedback overlay, and the foundation of the v0.3.0 UI redesign (bottom toolbar, contextual Properties panel, canvas chrome bar, export modal).

sections.heading: Tool System
items: Bottom toolbar with grouped tool faces (Select, Brush, Eraser, Focus, Mask)
Single-key shortcuts: V (Select), H (Hand), M (Marquee), X (Focus), B (Brush), E (Eraser), G (Mask), Space (temp Hand)
Tool-independent resize: corner handles work with any tool active
Keyboard Shortcuts reference modal (Ctrl+/)
Inline tool options panel beneath the toolbar

sections.heading: Masking System
items: First-class scene masks (Scene.masks[]) with local-coordinate geometry
Mask tool (G) with brush, rectangle, and ellipse shapes
Mask/Unmask modes: draw to hide or draw to restore
Additive masking: strokes stack by clip-path intersection
Subtractive unmask via Martinez-style polygon boolean difference
Frozen mask snapshots: opt-in whole-scene capture glued to the target
Background/canvas masks with transparent checkerboard visualization
Scene-level canvas masks: clip the whole scene, including content added later
Export mask punch: deterministic evenodd raster punch (foreignObject capture drops clip-paths)

sections.heading: Image Editing Tools
items: Paint Brush: per-stroke raster layers with friendly Paint N naming
Blur Brush: destructive blur on element bitmaps (brush + region tools)
Eraser: destination-out erase to transparent
Magic Eraser: tolerance-based flood-fill erase
Per-element image effects: 9 non-destructive adjustments (brightness, contrast, exposure, saturation, hue, gamma, temperature, tint, blur)
Image enhancements: opacity, border-radius, blend modes, flip, blur, glow, shadow
objectFit: fill for WYSIWYG aspect-ratio lock

sections.heading: Selection & Editing
items: Focus mode (X): group-scoped editing with dimming scrim and highlight ring
Element focus: works on every element kind; new elements auto-parent into the focused container with its clip lifted
Container clips: grouped elements clip to container shape at render time
Drag-to-nest: drag elements onto containers to parent them
Aspect ratio lock: per-element toggle, preserves shape without Shift
Alignment tools: 6-direction align + 4-direction distribute
Copy/Paste Style: transfer appearance between same-kind elements

sections.heading: Shapes
items: Gradient shape fills: solid + linear/radial/conic, identical on canvas, exports, and raster
Cross containers clip children to the exact union outline (no box fallback)
WYSIWYG resize: shapes track live resize bounds, never letterbox mid-gesture

sections.heading: Canvas & Viewport
items: Canvas chrome bar: scene tabs, zoom controls, View menu
Canvas empty state: first-run quick actions
Canvas rotation: Rotate 90° button
Transparent canvas toggle
Grid opacity slider
Interactive rulers and guides (drag, right-click to delete)

sections.heading: UI Redesign
items: Contextual Properties panel (empty / multi / single states)
Sectioned sidebar rail (Design, Content, Organize, View, History)
Dark / light UI theme with token system
14 shared component primitives (Modal, Menu, NumberInput, etc.)

versions.title: Dirty Tracking, Gesture Lifecycle & Export Correctness
versions.origin: Hardening release. Scene edits now mark the project dirty so unsaved work is never silently lost, in-flight gestures are cancelled on Escape/blur/reset so nothing commits against a later scene, and exports no longer leak user guides or ignore background overrides.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Editing the canvas (move/resize/brush/mask/effects) now marks the project dirty — closing, new, or open no longer silently discards changes
User guides no longer leak into exported images
Export background overrides (solid color / transparent) now actually apply
Resize commits only on pointer-up (like drag), so a cancelled resize leaves the document untouched
Escape / window blur / full reset cancel in-flight gestures (no stranded session commits against a later scene)
Window blur no longer leaves the app stuck in a temporary Hand tool
Removed an unvalidated save-image IPC channel (security fix)

sections.heading: Quality
items: 618 tests / 39 files passing; lint, typecheck, and production build clean
NSIS + portable packaging verified
